scripts.dev:api: npm run prepare:workspace && npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @workspace/api-server run dev
scripts.build: npm run prepare:workspace && npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 --filter @workspace/kike-code run build
scripts.typecheck: npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 run typecheck:libs && npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:full: npm run prepare:workspace && npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 --parallel --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/kike-code run dev
scripts.build:full: npm run prepare:workspace && npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 run typecheck && npx --yes pnpm@10.17.1 -r --if-present run build
